propositions: Legacy stores lack `.bridge_state/projects.json` and `bridge_project` fields, causing tickets to read as absent-project on upgrade and stopping sync
Migration must seed the projects mapping and set `legacy_default` without writing per-ticket EDIT events, as event-per-ticket writes would exceed MCP-boot lock budget and converge unpredictably
Two new ensure units (projects-seed, projects-compat-stamp) must be idempotent, check-then-act, and converge on init/re-init/fsck/MCP-boot without operator action
The seed unit writes one-project mapping only; the compat-stamp unit conditionally adds `multi-project-bridge` capability when mapping holds multiple projects and stamp is absent
Zero ticket events must be written during migration; the event-file set before and after sweep must be identical
A two-project stamped store must still pass `check_store_compat` on the current binary, and the token must be registered in `KNOWN_CAPABILITIES` before this story ships
